feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 11 -- Security drill-downs: MFA (/portal-v2/security/mfa, isMfaPage 4816-4972), Conditional Access baseline (/portal-v2/security/ca, isCaPage 4975-5039) and the three Evidence pages (isEvidencePage 5041-5202) -- OAuth Apps (/security/oauth), Legacy Authentication (/security/legacy-auth) and Email Security (/security/email). UI-only, design fixtures in secMfaData.ts / secCaData.ts / secEvidenceData.ts; the CA counts, the MFA control/partial/wizard derivations and evidence slug resolution are pinned by secCaModel.test.ts / secMfaModel.test.ts / secEvidenceModel.test.ts. The wrench opens the shared FixPanel (CR gate); the sparkle asks ShaneBot. Reached from the Security pillar area cards; no top-level nav rows.
notes: OAUTH STAT-CARD LIVE-DATA PASS (Git #1233): investigated all three evidence pages for real backing data behind their body content (stat cards, rows, top-risks, provenance). Only the OAuth page's 'Enterprise apps' and 'Tenant-wide consent' stat-card VALUES have a live check that is both real AND semantically correct for what the card claims (appgov:enterprise-app-count, appgov:risky-permission-grants — confirmed against monitor_checks). useSecEvidenceOauthLive overlays those two values via securityOauthPageWithLive; pv2-ev-oauth-stats-source reads 'live' once resolved. Everything else on all three pages stays fixture: no check exists for App-only permissions / Unverified publisher / Dormant apps / SPF lookups / Domains sending mail / Protocols reachable / Accounts using legacy / Legacy from odd geos, and two checks that superficially match a card label (identity:ca-legacy-auth-block, identity:legacy-auth-usage) turned out to be shallow/unfiltered on investigation — they'd fire 'true'/count-everything regardless of whether a legacy-auth block policy or legacy-protocol sign-in actually occurred, so wiring them would trade an honest fixture for a dishonest live value. See the #1233 issue comment for the full per-check breakdown.

LIVE-DATA PASS (Git #1204): the MFA, Conditional Access and Evidence drill-downs now read the SAME live war-room-pillars payload the Security pillar page does, through the shared useLivePillarHero seam -- NO second data path. The clipped pv2-mfa-source / pv2-ca-source / pv2-ev-source markers read 'live' when a real security score is on the wire. What STAYS fixture, a documented backend gap: the per-user MFA-gap rows and coverage %, and the per-evidence-type top-risks / provenance lists -- neither has a per-object producer on the war-room-pillars payload (finding-level and aggregate only). The A-SEC apiTest proves the real finding counts exist independent of whether the new markers have been deployed to the dev server yet.

CA ROWS LIVE-DATA PASS (Git #1232): the #1204 comment above previously listed the 22 named Conditional-Access policy rows as an unwireable gap -- that stopped being true once #339/#776/#782 shipped a real per-item producer (identity:ca-policy-count's real id/displayName/state, license:sku-utilization's real SKU inventory, both reachable via GET /api/portal/tenant-check-items). useCaBaselineLive now reads that route and secCaModel.ts's caBandsWithRowsLive() overlays each row's real status/note; the clipped pv2-ca-rows-source marker (separate from pv2-ca-source, which is only the hero score) reads 'live' once the check has genuinely run for the tenant. purpose text and which baselines require P2 stay Shane's own definitional naming/playbook content, not tenant data. The testbed tenant genuinely has 0 real Conditional Access policies today, so every row legitimately renders 'Missing' with an honest generic note -- not a defect.

MFA ROWS LIVE-DATA PASS (Git #1234): the #1204 comment above previously listed the per-user MFA-gap rows as an unwireable gap -- also stopped being true: identity:mfa-registration (real userDisplayName/isAdmin/isMfaRegistered per user, off /reports/authenticationMethods/userRegistrationDetails) is collected by the same item-detail pass and reachable via the same GET /api/portal/tenant-check-items route. useMfaRegistrationLive reads it and secMfaModel.ts's mfaGapUserRowsLive()/mfaPartialUserRowsLive() overlay the 'gaps'/'partial' states' real rows; the clipped pv2-mfa-rows-source marker (separate from pv2-mfa-source, the hero score) reads 'live' once the check has genuinely run. Named fixture rows (D. Cho, A. Reyes, etc.) only render before that first response lands or when the tenant has no collected rows -- MFA4 below asserts the section's static header label, not fixture names, since real names vary per tenant. The testbed tenant's own identity:mfa-registration check genuinely returns status 'license_gap' today (no P1/P2-class license to run the Graph userRegistrationDetails report), so pv2-mfa-rows-source legitimately reads 'fixture' there, not 'live' -- an honest fallback, verified against the tenant_check_item_details table directly, not a wiring bug. The 'MFA controls we check' panel stays fixture -- no current check collects authentication-methods-policy, registration-campaign or break-glass facts at item level -- but see the #1431 note below: the headline copy/counts no longer do.

MFA HERO/BANNER COUNTS NOW DERIVED, NOT LITERAL (Git #1431): follow-up from #1414's audit -- the 'gaps'/'partial' states' headline sentences and section-header/button counts ('8 accounts still don't have it', '2 are admin accounts', '2 of 5 users still haven't registered', 'Send enrollment reminder to 2 users') were hardcoded literals that never tracked the gapUsers/partialUsers rows sitting right below them, even on the SAME fixture (MFA_PARTIAL_USERS genuinely has 3 unregistered of 5, not the 2 the old copy claimed). These now derive from gapUsers.length / partialUsers.length / mfaUnregisteredCount() / gapUsers.filter(isAdminGapUser).length (secMfaModel.ts), live or fixture, so the numbers always match the rows rendered under them. The testbed tenant's fixture fallback (see MFA-ROWS-LIVE above) still surfaces '8'/'2' for the gaps state -- MFA_GAP_USERS itself didn't change -- but MFA4b/MFA11/MFA12 below pin the corrected admin-count and partial-count derivations, including the '3 of 5' fixture correction.

THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; skipping the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for an unrelated reason. On a WebView2 with a PERSISTED session the two input steps (#email/#password) can fail because the form never mounts -- with only those two red and every page assertion green, that is a PASS (portal-v2-manifest-login-block-persisted-session memory).

UI ROUTE SHAPE: the outer WouterRouter base is '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/shane-mccaw-consulting/portal-v2/security/<slug>. These are TWO-segment routes, declared at the App.tsx marker; '/portal-v2/:pillar' is a single-segment param route and cannot swallow them.

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- these routes are new in Part 11, so the dev server must carry this commit before they resolve. A run against a build that predates the deploy fails at the first assertion (NotFound / login), which is a not-deployed signal, not a page defect.

REAL INTERACTIONS DRIVEN: the MFA preview strip (MFA6-MFA9 switches the tenant state -- unconfigured wizard, healthy card -- real local UI state) and the Evidence provenance toggle + row expand (EV3-EV5). The CA counts and MFA derivations are pinned by their model tests rather than re-driven here.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

EMAIL STAT-CARD LIVE-DATA + HONEST-ROWS PASS (Git #1430, follow-up to #1414's audit): the Email Security evidence page was 100% EVIDENCE_PAGES fixture -- #1258 already registered a real, live-reachable security.emailAuthFindingCount (exchange:dkim-spf-dmarc-status) and already proved it reachable on the Security overview page's Email Security card, but this drill-down never consumed it. useSecEvidenceEmailLive + securityEmailPageWithLive now (a) prepend a live 'Open findings' stat card when the count resolves (a single aggregate, so it can only honestly back one new card -- the five existing per-record stat cards have no matching live producer and stay fixture, same partial-overlay contract #1233's OAuth pass uses), and (b) unconditionally clear the fabricated 'Domains' row list (fictional tenant.com + invented SPF/DKIM/DMARC records) to an honest 'No live scan data available yet' message, live metric or not, since the row list has no per-domain producer at all. Noted for a future issue: GET /api/portal/email-auth-status (email-auth-setup.tsx's seam) does carry real per-tenant SPF/DKIM/DMARC booleans for the tenant's own primary domain, but it's a different shape (one domain, three booleans, no record strings) than this page's 4-domain row fixture and was out of scope here per the issue's explicit direction.
